headline: Linde Expands Renewable Energy Sourcing in its EMEA and APAC Regions
summary: WOKING, England, July 27, 2026--Linde (Nasdaq: LIN) has signed six new power purchase agreements (PPAs) to source renewable electricity across Europe, Africa, and India.
